sections.title: Beat and audio
sections.text: Auto follows the BPM you set or tap; it does not detect the song's beat automatically. All timing runs on the device audio clock. Clean steps keep the original music clear; there is no Drive boost. Device Launch processes the selected IN to OUT. K1 Menu owns routing and App gains. Preview is silent until you choose the bundled 120 BPM Demo and enable host Listen; no microphone capture or device audio mirror.

sections.title: Saved settings

Previous sound settings remain in App data. Changing audio routes reopens audio and clears held gestures. Reload restarts processing; Exit releases audio.

sections.text: Hold to grip damps the shell; release to let it ring. Mute silences the sound. Open Tune for Seeds, Sand, Wood or Metal, sensitivity, fill and body size; Done returns to playing. E1–E4 work while playing. Your texture and settings are remembered. The shared Menu controls audio output and level. Preview requires Listen to preview for sound.

sections.title: Experimental model
sections.text: A bounded granular simulation uses real acceleration and angular velocity, friction, contacts and body resonances. It is a musical approximation, not a calibrated replica of a particular maraca. The device supplies motion; Preview offers an explicit tap test and requires Listen to preview. Missing motion quiets the live excitation, and closing the App releases the sensors and audio.

sections.title: Sound and timing
sections.text: The synth has no envelope of its own: its level is the level of your exhale, so it swells, holds and stops exactly as you breathe. How long you breathe sets the echo and reverb tails, from short after a quick puff to about five times longer after a breath of four seconds or more. Short wobbles inside one exhale do not end it. If your input only shows a jump when a breath starts and another when it stops, the first jump switches a steady amplifier on and the opposite jump switches it off. Grains come from a synthetic chord bed plus the captured breath, then pass through drive, filter, chorus, echo and reverb. Motion, pump and arpeggios follow each instrument's own tempo (66–160 BPM), not the outside session; a new breath after silence restarts them on the downbeat. HYPER clips by design. Silence stays silent. The microphone is read raw, without noise suppression or echo cancellation, so keep the speaker away from it or use headphones; hold K4 if the sound starts feeding back.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The instrument and all four macro positions save automatically and return on the next launch. Audio is released when the App exits.

Stand naturally at your playing position and press K2 or tap CALIBRATE to set the middle tone immediately. Lean toward the camera for bright, away for dark. Reset after changing position. This also works with hands overhead. Keep your face visible; if it is hidden, the current tone is held.

Keep your hands raised beside your head. Move your head toward your left hand for stronger bass and its reverb, or toward your right for stronger music and its reverb. Circle your head gently for a smooth stereo blend with trailing room sound. The colored links show each hand’s influence.
Adjust Bright / Dark sensitivity from 25% to 200%. Turn clockwise for more response, counterclockwise for less. Starts at 50%; your setting saves automatically. K2 calibration stays set.

Hold both hands clearly above the top of your head to switch to vocals. Once playing, vocals continue if your hands leave through the top of the picture while your head and shoulders stay visible. Bring either hand back below your head to stop vocals.

Immediately set your current position as the tone midpoint. Keep your face visible. Raising your arms does not reset or change the tone midpoint. Press again after changing position. The midpoint survives brief tracking loss; Reload starts a fresh session.

Each part fades in when raised and fades out when lowered. Switching to or from vocals crossfades the parts, with reverb trailing naturally. Song time pauses after the last part fades out; raising an arm resumes from there.

sections.title: Audio and saved settings
sections.text: Echo cancellation defaults ON in Menu → Device → Audio; your choice is remembered. Preview never captures a microphone: choose Listen to preview, then Demo. Voice, Pitch, Size, Texture, Output and comparison save automatically; other voices’ adjustments last for this launch. Original comparison shares timing and output volume. Goblin preserves high-band articulation during large pitch changes.
